display.purpose: Short section claims with maximum visual weight.

label.purpose: Uppercase actions, tabs, and compact headings.

readout.purpose: Measurements, results, equations, and code-adjacent evidence.

shadows.name: plotter-contact
shadows.purpose: Places the transparent carriage physically above the primary plot.

motion.name: run-cycle-minimum
motion.purpose: Keeps the root in the running state long enough for the calibration sweep to complete before passed or failed is shown.

motion.name: plotting-live-enter
motion.purpose: Reveals the plotting/live flag through opacity and a 0.4rem upward move while the suite is running.

motion.name: plot-sweep
motion.purpose: Moves a one-pixel blue calibration line 880px across the graph during the running state.

motion.name: robust-calibrate
motion.purpose: Advances the robust trace dash offset while the suite is running.

motion.name: carriage-calibrate
motion.purpose: Oscillates the carriage by two pixels and shifts its contact shadow toward plotting blue during the running state.

motion.name: trace-draw
motion.purpose: Draws a completed model trace from its dashed offset.

motion.name: carriage-settle
motion.purpose: Settles the carriage after a successful suite run.

motion.name: point-print
motion.purpose: Reprints completed plot points from 30% scale and zero opacity, delayed by calc(var(--point-index) * 16ms + 180ms).

motion.name: control-punch
motion.purpose: Compresses the selected tab and family link to 96% between a raised-paper inset and plotting-blue outer rule.

motion.name: lab-enter
motion.purpose: Brings refreshed family evidence in from 0.6rem below and 25% opacity.

motion.name: panel-scan
motion.purpose: Sweeps a narrow plotting-blue registration band across the refreshed lab panel.

motion.name: row-print
motion.purpose: Prints result rows from 1.25rem left, delayed by calc(var(--row-index) * 36ms + 120ms).

motion.name: code-print
motion.purpose: Reveals the refreshed code field from left to right with clip-path.

motion.name: family-shortcut-delay
motion.purpose: Defers family activation until the smooth scroll reaches the labs; reduced motion uses zero delay.

motion.name: copy-press
motion.purpose: Compresses the copy action to 94% while the clipboard write is pending.

motion.name: copy-confirm
motion.purpose: Raises the successful copy action by two pixels with a soft system-green confirmation ring.

motion.name: copy-error
motion.purpose: Shakes the failed copy action by three pixels while safety orange and recovery text identify the error.

motion.name: running-spin
motion.purpose: Turns the action marker into a running indicator.

motion.name: reduced-motion-policy
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Disables run, plot, carriage, point, control, panel, row, code, and copy motion; resolves trace offsets, point visibility, state transitions, scrolling, and shortcut activation immediately.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Compact mechanical action for running the suite or copying code.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.55rem; border:1px solid var(--graphite); border-radius:0; padding:.65rem .85rem; color:var(--paper-raised); background:var(--graphite); font:800 .7rem/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary__mark { width:0; height:0; border-top:5px solid transparent; border-bottom:5px solid transparent; border-left:8px solid currentColor; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--ink); border-color:var(--ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:progress; opacity:.65; } .ds-btn-primary.is-running .ds-btn-primary__mark { width:10px; height:10px; border:2px solid currentColor; border-right-color:transparent; border-radius:50%; animation:ds-running-spin .75s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-running-spin { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-btn-primary.is-running .ds-btn-primary__mark { animation:none; } }

components.name: Family Tab
components.description: A ruled family selector that becomes plotting blue when selected and triggers the evidence-panel entrance.
components.css: .ds-family-tab { min-width:9rem; min-height:3.5rem; border:0; border-right:1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius:0; color:var(--graphite); background:transparent; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-strong); font:800 .75rem/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-family-tab:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-family-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color:var(--paper-raised); background:var(--ink); } .ds-family-tab.is-activating { animation:ds-control-punch 480ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-family-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-family-tab:active { filter:brightness(.92); } @keyframes ds-control-punch { 0% { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-strong); transform:scale(1); } 35% { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--paper-raised), 0 0 0 3px var(--ink); transform:scale(.96); } 100% { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-strong); transform:scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-family-tab.is-activating { animation:none; } }

components.name: Family Index Link
components.description: A ruled navigation cell synchronized to the selected lab family through its active class and aria-current.
components.css: .ds-family-link { display:flex; min-width:9rem; min-height:3.5rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:.75rem .35rem; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong); color:var(--graphite); background:var(--paper); font:800 clamp(.7rem, .74vw, .8rem)/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing:.1em; text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-family-link:hover, .ds-family-link.is-active { color:var(--paper-raised); background:var(--ink); } .ds-family-link.is-activating { animation:ds-control-punch 480ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-family-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-family-link:active { filter:brightness(.92); } @keyframes ds-control-punch { 0% { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-strong); transform:scale(1); } 35% { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--paper-raised), 0 0 0 3px var(--ink); transform:scale(.96); } 100% { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule-strong); transform:scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-family-link.is-activating { animation:none; } }

components.name: Family Evidence Panel
components.description: The ruled table-and-code panel re-enters whenever the selected family changes.
components.css: .ds-lab-panel { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0, 1.35fr) minmax(20rem, .65fr); min-height:12rem; overflow:hidden; border-bottom:1px solid var(--graphite); color:var(--graphite); background:var(--paper); } .ds-lab-panel::after { content:""; position:absolute; z-index:5; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 46%, rgba(18,57,197,.08) 48%, var(--ink) 50%, rgba(18,57,197,.08) 52%, transparent 54% 100%); pointer-events:none; opacity:0; transform:translateX(-100%); } .ds-lab-panel>div, .ds-lab-panel>pre { margin:0; padding:1.5rem; } .ds-lab-readout table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font:400 .75rem/1.45 var(--mono); } .ds-lab-readout td { padding:.5rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-lab-panel>pre { border-left:1px solid var(--graphite); color:#dce2ff; background:#161b30; font:400 .8rem/1.45 var(--mono); } .ds-lab-panel.is-switching { animation:ds-lab-enter 520ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-lab-panel.is-switching::after { animation:ds-panel-scan 680ms cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1) both; } .ds-lab-panel.is-switching .ds-lab-readout tbody tr { animation:ds-row-print 360ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; animation-delay:calc(var(--row-index) * 36ms + 120ms); } .ds-lab-panel.is-switching>pre { animation:ds-code-print 560ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-lab-panel:hover { border-bottom-color:var(--ink); } .ds-lab-panel:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; } @keyframes ds-lab-enter { from { opacity:.25; transform:translateY(.6rem); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } } @keyframes ds-panel-scan { 0% { opacity:0; transform:translateX(-100%); } 20%, 78% { opacity:1; } 100% { opacity:0; transform:translateX(100%); } } @keyframes ds-row-print { from { opacity:0; transform:translateX(-1.25rem); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateX(0); } } @keyframes ds-code-print { from { opacity:.2; clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { opacity:1; clip-path:inset(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-lab-panel.is-switching, .ds-lab-panel.is-switching::after, .ds-lab-panel.is-switching .ds-lab-readout tbody tr, .ds-lab-panel.is-switching>pre { animation:none; } }

components.name: Proof Readout
components.description: A ruled metric pairing a compact equipment label with a tabular result.
components.css: .ds-proof-readout { display:flex; min-height:5.5rem; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; gap:.12rem; padding:0 1rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); color:var(--graphite); background:var(--paper); } .ds-proof-readout span { color:var(--graphite-muted); font:.7rem/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-proof-readout strong { color:#424542; font:400 clamp(.85rem, 1.65vw, 1.75rem)/1 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-proof-readout:hover strong { color:var(--ink); } .ds-proof-readout:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Ruled Data Table
components.description: Dense evidence table with tabular figures and one-pixel row rules.
components.css: .ds-proof-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:var(--graphite-muted); background:var(--paper); font:400 .75rem/1.45 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-proof-table caption { padding:0 0 .45rem; font:800 .75rem/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing:.08em; text-align:left; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-proof-table th, .ds-proof-table td { padding:.32rem .2rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); text-align:left; } .ds-proof-table th:last-child, .ds-proof-table td:last-child { text-align:right; } .ds-proof-table tbody tr:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-proof-table:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; }

components.css: .ds-plot-legend { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.65rem; padding:.65rem; color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper); font:400 .75rem/1.35 var(--sans); text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-plot-legend>div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2rem 6rem 1fr; gap:.35rem; align-items:center; } .ds-plot-legend code { color:var(--ink); font:400 .75rem/1.35 var(--mono); text-transform:none; } .ds-key { display:block; height:2px; background:var(--ink); } .ds-key--poly { background:var(--ink-light); } .ds-key--robust { height:1px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--graphite) 0 6px, transparent 6px 10px); } .ds-plot-legend:hover { color:var(--graphite); } .ds-plot-legend:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Copy Action
components.description: Clipboard action with distinct pending, confirmed, and recoverable-error feedback that resets after 1.2 seconds.
components.css: .ds-copy-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border:1px solid var(--graphite); border-radius:0; padding:.45rem .7rem; color:var(--paper-raised); background:var(--graphite); font:800 .7rem/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-copy-action:hover { background:var(--ink); border-color:var(--ink); } .ds-copy-action.is-copying { animation:ds-copy-press 260ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } .ds-copy-action.is-copied { animation:ds-copy-confirm 620ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; background:#16702a; border-color:#16702a; } .ds-copy-action.is-error { animation:ds-copy-error 320ms ease-in-out both; background:var(--orange); border-color:var(--orange); } .ds-copy-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange); outline-offset:4px; } @keyframes ds-copy-confirm { 35% { box-shadow:0 0 0 .45rem rgba(22,112,42,.18); transform:translateY(-2px); } } @keyframes ds-copy-press { 50% { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--paper-raised); transform:scale(.94); } } @keyframes ds-copy-error { 25%, 75% { transform:translateX(-3px); } 50% { transform:translateX(3px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-copy-action.is-copying, .ds-copy-action.is-copied, .ds-copy-action.is-error { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview:
regressio feels like a calibrated technical sheet caught midway through a proof run: cool paper, exact graphite rulings, measured readouts, and a saturated blue pen trace. Information stays exposed and continuous. The visual hierarchy comes from scale, alignment, and ruled partitions instead of a collection of floating dashboard cards.

The system is dense but calm. Large condensed headlines establish the claim, monospaced measurements make evidence scannable, and the realistic plotter carriage gives the otherwise flat world one physical signature. Every expressive move should help a developer see the suite pass, follow the trace, or inspect the underlying results.
keyCharacteristics: Cool drafting-paper ground with graphite structure.
Saturated plotting blue for active traces, selections, and positive proof emphasis.
Safety orange reserved for failures and the keyboard focus ring.
Condensed sans-serif hierarchy paired with tabular monospaced evidence.
Registration marks, calibration ticks, ruled tabs, and plots without card shells.
A single plotter carriage supplies the system's realistic material accent.
State-driven motion separates calibration, proof drawing, and family inspection.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Plotting blue carries the active trace and current selection; keep it scarce enough that the live result remains the clearest blue object.

rules.name: The Safety Exception Rule
rules.body: Safety orange appears only when the interface requires immediate attention: a failed proof or a visible keyboard focus target.

rules.name: The Continuous Sheet Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with graphite rules and alignment before introducing another surface color.

rules.name: The Measured Evidence Rule
rules.body: Numbers, equations, timings, and runtime states use the monospaced readout face with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Condensed Claim Rule
rules.body: Large statements use a tight condensed display; do not expand them into wide, soft marketing typography.

rules.name: The Dominant Plot Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, reserve roughly four-fifths of the proof sheet for the drawing field and one-fifth for vertically aligned evidence.

rules.name: The Stack Without Cards Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts preserve ruled continuity by stacking the same regions and borders; they do not turn those regions into detached cards.

rules.name: The One Physical Object Rule
rules.body: Realistic depth belongs to the plotter carriage; all interface surfaces remain flat and ruled.

rules.name: The Instrument Geometry Rule
rules.body: Use straight edges for information and circles for instrument state or calibration details.

rules.name: The State-Machine Motion Rule
rules.body: Motion must explain a real state change: calibration belongs to `running`, drawing and printing belong to `passed`, family feedback belongs to a changed selection, and copy feedback belongs to clipboard state.

dos: Do keep evidence visible: pair claims with live values, equations, timings, or status.
Do use one-pixel graphite rules to create hierarchy across continuous paper.
Do reserve plotting blue for the active trace, selected controls, and explicit proof emphasis.
Do use monospaced tabular figures for measurements and results.
Do keep running, passed, failed, family-selection, and clipboard motion tied to their semantic states, with an immediate reduced-motion path.
Do let the plotter carriage be the one realistic, shadowed signature.
donts: Don't break proof surfaces into rounded, floating dashboard cards.
Don't add decorative shadows to tabs, tables, buttons, or proof blocks.
Don't use safety orange as a general accent or decorative highlight.
Don't crowd the sheet with multiple realistic machines or competing hero objects.
Don't replace ruled structure with soft containers, gradients, or ornamental chrome.
